title: Portuguese Vegan Casserole
description: A hearty, plant-based take on the classic Portuguese casserole, featuring a rich tomato sauce and savory vegetables.

ingredients.name: Portuguese
ingredients.amount: 1 cup (250g) of dried beans (such as black beans or chickpeas)

instructions: In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the dried beans to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes.
